perspectives.query: SELECT r.id, r.blr_index, r.word, r.word_tone, r.english, r.french, r.noun_class, r.distribution, r.proto_kk, r.note, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.c1, ''), '∅') AS c1, COALESCE(NULLIF(vs.v11, ''), '∅') AS v11, COALESCE(NULLIF(vs.v12, ''), '∅') AS v12, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.c2, ''), '∅') AS c2, COALESCE(NULLIF(vs.v21, ''), '∅') AS v21, COALESCE(NULLIF(vs.v22, ''), '∅') AS v22, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.c3, ''), '∅') AS c3, COALESCE(NULLIF(vs.v3, ''), '∅') AS v3, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.c4, ''), '∅') AS c4, COALESCE(NULLIF(vs.v4, ''), '∅') AS v4, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.cs, ''), '∅') AS cs, COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.t11, ''), '∅') AS t11, COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.t12, ''), '∅') AS t12, COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.t21, ''), '∅') AS t21, COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.t22, ''), '∅') AS t22, COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.t3, ''), '∅') AS t3, COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.t4, ''), '∅') AS t4, rel.value AS reliability, con.name AS contributor FROM reconstruction r LEFT JOIN blrconsonantstructure cs ON cs.id = r.consonant_structure_id LEFT JOIN blrvowelstructure vs ON vs.id = r.vowel_structure_id LEFT JOIN blrtonestructure ts ON ts.id = r.tone_structure_id LEFT JOIN blrreliability rel ON rel.id = r.reliability_id LEFT JOIN blrcontributor con ON con.id = r.contributor_id

SELECT r.id, r.term, r.translation, r.meaning, r.semantic_field, r.part_of_speech, r.ipa, r.blr_index, rc.word AS blr_word, rc.english AS blr_english, CASE WHEN NULLIF(r.blr_index, '') IS NOT NULL THEN r.blr_index || COALESCE(' · ' || NULLIF(rc.english, ''), '') END AS blr_label, COALESCE(v.name_english, v.name_bantu, v.name_french) AS variety, v.guthrie_index AS guthrie, CASE WHEN v.guthrie_index GLOB '[A-Z]*' THEN substr(v.guthrie_index, 1, 1) END AS zone, c.latitude, c.longitude FROM reflex r LEFT JOIN variety v ON v.id = r.variety_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_id, min(id) AS id FROM coordinate WHERE description = 'default' GROUP BY location_id) d ON d.location_id = r.location_id LEFT JOIN coordinate c ON c.id = d.id LEFT JOIN reconstruction rc ON rc.blr_index = r.blr_index
